newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM Int. plans Dutch listing, share offer.
newsitem.headline: ASM Int. plans Dutch listing, share offer.

text.p: ASM International NV said on Tuesday it planned a listing on the Amsterdam bourse and a share offering.
ASM International said it planned to offer 1.0 to 1.5 million common shares outside the United States.
Additionally, existing shareholders were expected to offer 1.5 to 2.5 million common shares for sale, it said.
Advanced Semiconductor Materials International NV (ASM International), based in the Dutch town of Bilthoven, makes equipment and materials used to produce semiconductor devices.
Its shares are already listed on the Nasdaq exchange in the U.S. and earlier this year the company said it also planned to seek a listing on the Amsterdams bourse.
In its statement on Tuesday the company said its shareholders had now approved changes in its articles of association which would allow it to go ahead with these plans.
The Amsterdam listing and the accompanying share offering are intended to create extra liquidity for existing and potential European investors in ASM International, ASM said.
